newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Kawasaki, Itochu enter China motorbike engine pact.
newsitem.headline: Kawasaki, Itochu enter China motorbike engine pact.

text.p: Hainan New Continent Motorcycle Co Ltd and Japan's Kawasaki Heavy and Itochu Fuel will set up a US$29.9 million motorbike engine venture, said an official press report on Monday.
The venture is to begin production at the end of 1997, the Shenzhen-based Securities Times said.
New Continent will have a 51 percent stake in the project, based in Haikou, the capital of southern Hainan province, a spokesman for the Chinese company said.
Kawasaki will hold 33 percent and Itochu Fuel 16 percent, he said.
New Continent said recently that its interim net earnings for 1996 were 65.96 million yuan versus 33.04 million a year earlier.
The company spokesman said New Continent forecast net earnings of 150 million yuan for full year 1996, compared with 70.57 million in 1995.
The company spokesman said it expects its output of motorbikes to climb to 500,000 this year from 200,000 in 1995.
